text: Practice how to calculate Protection Priority mobility points beyond its minimum.
Only complete extra ten-km/h steps count toward this particular rated criterion.
Example: A Protection Priority design reaches 105 km/h mobility. How many rated points come from mobility alone?
105 - 80 = 25 km/h above the minimum. Two full steps of 10 km/h earn 20 points each, for 40 points.
An incomplete mobility increment has no extra Protection Priority points.
